golden.label_scope: Held-out synthetic cases for the attention signals (the code that marks a case 'look at this first'): 32 cases a careful operator would want a person to see first (tag needs_person: security incidents, legal or privacy requests, distress or danger, attempts to steer routing or approval) and 32 ordinary cases, 16 of them lookalikes that use nearby words. Written and labelled by the developer on 2026-11-11 from the four kinds' descriptions, before the first signal phrase list existed and without re-reading the hard auto-send set; committed before the phrase list. Never used to choose a phrase. The same developer wrote the phrase list afterwards, so this is weaker than an independent set. Categories follow the triage prompt's definitions. Invented people and events only; no real customer data and not independent ground truth.
golden.name: case_triage_attention_heldout_v1
